prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.go in package solution.
Required API: func RunSession(events []string) (string, bool)
Behavior: Start in closed. Legal transitions are closed/open -> open, open/authenticate -> ready, ready/ping -> ready, and open or ready/close -> closed. Reject the whole sequence on any other event/state pair; otherwise return the final state.
Visible example: [open, authenticate, ping, close] returns closed; [open, ping] is rejected.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code:
package solution
func RunSession(events []string)(string,bool){state:="closed";for _,e:=range events{switch state+":"+e{case "closed:open":state="open";case "open:authenticate":state="ready";case "open:close","ready:close":state="closed";case "ready:ping":default:return "",false}};return state,true}
